# Missing command descriptions

Commands whose store description is missing or too thin. Each should get a proper description in the store, written with `dev.code.set_command_meta` (pass the new `desc`; an empty `groups` leaves the groups as they are). Until then the reference shows text inferred from the code, marked *(inferred)*.

Inferred text lives in `inferred-descriptions.json` next to these pages, keyed by full name, with a hash of the code it was written from. *stale* means the code has changed since.

| Command | Store description | Reference shows |
|---|---|---|
| [`app.app.remembersession`](app.md#appappremembersession) | Keep the current session logged in | store text + inferred detail |
| [`peer.peer.local`](peer.md#peerpeerlocal) | Execute the given remote request as a local HTTP request. | store text + inferred detail |
| [`security.security.current_user`](security.md#securitysecuritycurrent_user) | Retrieve the system metadata for the currently logged in user | store text + inferred detail |
